## Context / Problem
Eighteen `tests/unit` modules contain 36 audited prose blocks: 28 leading docstrings and 8 full-line comment regions (4,108 before-words), frozen at `origin/main@d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84`. Revalidation split the composite `conftest.py` range, removed two stale ranges that now contain executable code, and pruned the already-concise `classify` rationale.

## Approach
Edit only the frozen prose blocks below. A `D:<owner>` is the leading `Expr(Constant(str))` in a `Module`, `ClassDef`, `FunctionDef`, or `AsyncFunctionDef`. A `C:<scope>:before:<anchor>` is one maximal consecutive full-line COMMENT-token region, owned by the innermost AST scope and anchored to the next unchanged non-comment code. Compact `D{a,b}` and `C{scope@anchor,...}` notation expands to those exact IDs under the row's path; the reviewer writes the fully path-qualified `<path>#<ID>`.

For every owned path, retain immutable before and final blobs and parse both with `ast.parse(..., type_comments=True)`. On comparison copies remove only allowlisted leading docstring nodes; normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; require the remaining `ast.dump(..., include_attributes=False)` values to match. Tokenize both blobs and reject changed inline comments or non-allowlisted full-line comments. Preserve runtime strings, regexes, prompts, imports, decorators, annotations, assertions, subprocess arguments, test data, shebangs, and complete directive-bearing physical lines exactly. Only adjacent blank-line normalization around an edited block is allowed.

## Stable block allowlist
